---
title: "Array data read where it lives"
subtitle: "Virtual stores for Antarctic and Southern Ocean arrays, ausantarctic on source.coop"
toc: false
---

Each dataset's chunk index is read once into a table of byte references:
which bytes of which file hold each chunk. Every published form (GDAL
multidimensional VRT, kerchunk, Icechunk, STAC) is rendered from that one
table and checked against GDAL reading the original files. No data is copied
to make an index.
